# Project Inventory

This folder stores project-level inventories and public metadata about mine ownership, value-chain roles, and project status.

Commercial database exports should not be committed. Record their existence and allowed use in `commercial_sources.md` instead.

Current public workbook:

- `自下而上_非洲关键矿产项目与价值流向资料库.xlsx`: project-level inventory for critical mineral assets and value-flow notes.
